text:
sophia-p: Quick heads-up 1: Candidate (Priya Menon) on work visa says her embassy appointment ran long; she'll land later than planned. Her interview day is 09:00-15:30 with a paired programming exercise at 13:00 that we prefer onsite.

kevin-g: Which slots are must-be-in-person? I can move my 10:30 panel to 14:30 if that helps.

sophia-p: Must in-person = 13:00 paired-programming lab. Everything else can be remote. Plan: create backup Meet links for morning, reserve Quiet Room C 12:30-16:00 for prep, and prepare local test VM for the lab in case her laptop has issues.

recruiter-bot: Candidate profile: Priya Menon (work_permit: H1B), contact priya.m@example.com, needs parking. Prefers afternoon onsite if possible.

office-bot: Quiet Room C reserved 12:30-16:00. Parking permit emailed. Local test VM image (redwood-lab-v2) reserved on Lab Host 3.

sophia-p: Panel note: please add backup Meet to your invites and be ready to switch early slots remote. Kevin, can you shift to 14:30?

kevin-g: Yes, I moved my 10:30 -> 14:30.

sophia-p: I'll offer a taxi stipend up to $80 if she misses the shuttle and will ship a power adapter if needed. @recruiter-bot queue the candidate message.

recruiter-bot: Message queued to candidate (recorded here):

```
Hi Priya 1: Sorry about the embassy delay. We can run your morning interviews remotely and keep the paired-programming lab onsite at 13:00. Backup Meet link: https://meet.google.com/priya-backup. Quiet Room C reserved for you 12:30-16:00 and a test VM will be ready for the lab. We can cover taxi up to $80 and ship a charger if needed. Please confirm preference.
```

candidate-bot: Candidate replied at 08:20: "Thanks! I'll aim for the onsite lab and need the charger if possible"

sophia-p: Charger shipment approved. Ops-shipping will send a USB-C travel charger, tracking 1Z888111222. Please do not offer dairy snacks (she's lactose intolerant).

office-bot: Charger marked for same-day courier pick-up. Quiet Room C will have a whiteboard and HDMI adapter ready.

sophia-p: Final update at 10:05 1: candidate arrived 12:45, used Quiet Room C to set up, ran remote morning interviews, completed paired-programming onsite at 13:00 using the test VM. Candidate appreciated the smooth pivot. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
